PL54 Stainless Steel Pool Light Niche

Professional Recessed Housing for PL54 Underwater Pool Lighting

The PL54 Stainless Steel Pool Light Niche is a professional-grade recessed mounting housing designed to provide a secure, organized, and serviceable installation platform for the PL54 underwater pool light. Installed within the pool wall, the niche creates the dedicated cavity required to properly position the lighting fixture while maintaining a clean, integrated appearance that complements modern residential and commercial swimming pools.

Manufactured from durable stainless steel, the niche is engineered for demanding pool environments where constant exposure to moisture and long-term structural reliability must be considered. Its rigid construction provides a stable mounting foundation for the PL54 while helping protect and organize the components located behind the visible pool light.

One of the niche’s most important functions is providing adequate space behind the fixture for cable management. Rather than forcing wiring into a confined area, the recessed housing gives installers room to route and organize the PL54’s electrical cable as it transitions toward the pool’s conduit system. Proper cable accommodation also supports future servicing by allowing sufficient cable length to remain behind the fixture when installation conditions permit.

The niche is also designed to provide a convenient connection point between the underwater lighting location and the electrical conduit system. This creates a more organized installation pathway for the low-voltage wiring running from the pool light toward the appropriate junction, transformer, or control equipment.

Because the PL54 is mounted to a dedicated niche rather than permanently built into the pool structure, the lighting fixture can be more easily accessed for inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, or replacement. This service-friendly configuration can reduce the need to disturb surrounding pool finishes when the light requires attention in the future.

Its recessed installation also contributes to a cleaner finished appearance. Once the PL54 light is installed over the niche, the housing remains concealed within the pool wall, allowing the visible stainless-steel light assembly to sit neatly against the finished pool surface.

Designed as an integral part of a professional underwater lighting installation, the PL54 Stainless Steel Pool Light Niche combines durability, installation flexibility, cable-management space, and convenient service access in one purpose-built housing.

Key Benefits: Heavy-duty stainless-steel construction • Dedicated recessed housing for the PL54 • Secure pool-wall mounting • Organized cable and conduit routing • Space for service cable • Easier fixture removal and maintenance • Clean, integrated finished appearance • Suitable for professional residential and commercial pool installations.

Upgrade your existing TSRPT Manual Transformer with the TSR LCD Astronomic Timer, a smart and convenient control solution designed to automate your landscape lighting according to natural sunset and sunrise times.

Instead of relying on a basic fixed-time schedule that may require frequent adjustments throughout the year, the TSR LCD uses astronomic scheduling based on your programmed location. Smarter Landscape Lighting Control

The TSR LCD is designed for customers who want the simplicity of automatic lighting control without replacing their existing TSRPT transformer.

Automatic Sunset and Sunrise Scheduling

One of the key advantages of the TSR LCD is its ability to operate according to astronomic sunset and sunrise times.

Traditional timers often operate at the same clock time every day. However, sunset may occur much earlier in winter and significantly later during summer. This can result in lights turning on too early, too late, or remaining on longer than necessary.

The TSR LCD helps solve this problem by automatically adjusting the lighting schedule as daylight hours change.

The result is a landscape-lighting system that operates more naturally throughout the year.

Seasonal Time Adjustment

With a conventional timer, users may need to manually change the programmed schedule several times per year as sunrise and sunset times shift.

The TSR LCD reduces this inconvenience by automatically accounting for seasonal daylight changes once the system has been properly programmed.

This means:

For homeowners, property managers, and contractors maintaining multiple lighting systems, this can significantly simplify routine operation.

Once the initial setup is completed, the system is designed to operate automatically with minimal day-to-day attention.

This provides a practical solution for existing installations where the transformer is still functioning properly but greater automation is desired.

Instead of upgrading the entire landscape-lighting power system, the TSR LCD allows customers to add smarter scheduling capability directly to the compatible transformer.

Reduce Unnecessary Lighting Runtime

Automating landscape lighting around actual sunset and sunrise conditions can help prevent fixtures from operating when illumination is not needed.

Reducing unnecessary runtime can provide several advantages:

  • Lower energy consumption
  • Reduced operating hours
  • Less unnecessary use of lamps and LED components
  • Potentially longer fixture and lamp service life
  • More efficient transformer operation
  • Reduced need for manual switching

For larger landscape-lighting systems containing numerous fixtures, better scheduling can make a meaningful difference in overall system efficiency.

Reliable, Hands-Free Operation

Once installed and programmed, the TSR LCD provides convenient automatic operation every day.

Homeowners no longer need to remember to manually switch their landscape lights on each evening or off each morning. Likewise, property managers can maintain a more consistent lighting schedule without making frequent seasonal timer adjustments.

The system helps ensure that pathways, gardens, entrances, driveways, and architectural features remain illuminated when they are most needed.

Ideal for Complete Landscape Lighting Systems

It can help automate lighting for:

  • Spotlights
  • Well lights
  • Step lights
  • Hardscape lighting
  • Garden lighting
  • Driveway lighting
  • Architectural accent lighting
  • Outdoor entertainment areas
  • Commercial landscape installations

When paired with a compatible TSRPT Manual Transformer, the TSR LCD provides a convenient central scheduling solution for the connected landscape-lighting system.

Automatic Astronomic Scheduling

Seasonal Adjustment

Convenient LCD Interface

Transformer Upgrade Solution

Reduced Fixture Runtime

CDPA76 Integrated Tall Aluminum Path Light

Create a dramatic and inviting outdoor atmosphere with the CDPA76 Integrated Aluminum Path Light from ABBA Lighting USA. Standing an impressive 61.2 inches tall, this distinctive fixture combines the visual presence of a decorative torch with the efficiency and reliability of modern low-voltage LED technology.

Its integrated 1.7W LED produces 160 lumens of warm light with full 360° distribution, creating a soft circle of illumination around pathways, entrances, garden beds, patios, and outdoor gathering areas. The tall silhouette makes the CDPA76 an excellent choice for customers seeking a landscape light that serves as both a functional lighting source and a striking architectural accent.

Distinctive Tall Architectural Design

Unlike conventional path lights that remain close to the ground, the CDPA76 reaches approximately 5.1 feet in height. This elevated design allows the fixture to stand above flowers, ornamental grasses, shrubs, and surrounding landscape materials.

Its tall profile makes it especially effective for creating visual rhythm along long walkways, driveway borders, courtyards, resort grounds, and large garden areas. During the day, it adds a refined vertical element to the landscape. After sunset, it becomes an attractive source of surrounding illumination.

Full 360° Light Distribution

The CDPA76 provides a complete 360° beam angle, distributing light evenly around the fixture instead of concentrating illumination in only one direction.

This full-circle lighting pattern can help:

  • Illuminate both sides of a pathway
  • Add visibility around garden and planting areas
  • Define driveway and courtyard borders
  • Reduce dark areas between fixtures
  • Create balanced pools of light
  • Add depth and atmosphere throughout the landscape

The uniform distribution is particularly valuable in open areas, pathway intersections, outdoor seating spaces, and locations where surrounding illumination is preferred.

Energy-Efficient Integrated LED

The CDPA76 features a built-in 1.7W LED module, eliminating the need to purchase or install a separate bulb.

Its integrated design provides several practical advantages:

  • No separate replacement bulb required
  • Exceptionally low energy consumption
  • Consistent lighting performance
  • Reduced routine maintenance
  • Clean, streamlined construction
  • Convenient low-voltage operation

Despite consuming only 1.7 watts, the fixture produces 160 lumens, making it an energy-conscious solution for projects requiring multiple lights throughout a property.

Warm and Inviting Illumination

The primary specification section lists the CDPA76 with a warm 2700K color temperature. This soft-white lighting tone creates a comfortable and relaxing nighttime atmosphere while complementing greenery, natural stone, brick, wood, stucco, and other exterior materials.

Warm illumination is especially effective for:

  • Residential gardens
  • Outdoor dining areas
  • Resort and hotel grounds
  • Courtyards and patios
  • Decorative pathways
  • Entry and arrival areas

The softer color temperature helps create an upscale decorative effect without the harsh appearance associated with cooler daylight-white lighting.

Heavy-Duty Cast Aluminum Construction

The CDPA76 is manufactured from heavy-duty cast aluminum, providing a strong yet practical fixture body for permanent outdoor installation.

Its durable construction is designed for exposure to common landscape conditions, including rain, irrigation, dust, and seasonal weather. The professional Black finish gives the fixture a clean and sophisticated appearance while coordinating with modern, transitional, and traditional outdoor environments.

The dark finish also allows the fixture body to blend naturally with greenery and nighttime surroundings, keeping the illumination as the primary visual focus.

AC/DC 12V Low-Voltage Operation

The CDPA76 operates on a compatible 12V AC/DC low-voltage landscape-lighting system.

Low-voltage operation makes the fixture practical for residential and commercial projects requiring several lights throughout pathways, gardens, entrances, and outdoor gathering areas. A properly sized transformer should be selected based on the total connected wattage, cable length, and anticipated voltage drop.

The fixture is non-dimmable, providing consistent illumination whenever the landscape-lighting system is activated.

IP65 Outdoor Protection

With an IP65 waterproof rating, the CDPA76 is designed to resist dust, rain, moisture, and common landscape-irrigation exposure.

This weather-resistant protection supports dependable year-round installation in residential, commercial, hospitality, and recreational environments. Approved waterproof direct-burial connectors should be used at every electrical connection to protect the complete lighting system from moisture and corrosion.

Installation Components Included

Each CDPA76 includes:

  • Heavy-duty aluminum ground spike
  • 18/2 direct-burial landscape-lighting wire lead

The aluminum spike allows the fixture to be securely positioned in soil, grass, mulch, or planting beds. The stake-mounted configuration also provides flexibility when evaluating fixture spacing and illumination before completing the final electrical connections.

The CDPA76 is an excellent lighting solution for:

  • Residential walkways
  • Garden pathways
  • Driveway borders
  • Landscape and flower beds
  • Front entrances
  • Patios and courtyards
  • Outdoor dining and seating areas
  • Hotels and resorts
  • Apartment communities
  • Parks and recreational spaces
  • Office and retail properties
  • Commercial pedestrian areas

Its unusual height makes it especially suitable for larger landscapes where standard low-profile path lights may be hidden by plants or lack sufficient visual presence.

The CDPA76 is covered under ABBA Lighting USA’s three-year warranty for aluminum fixtures with built-in LEDs, subject to the company’s warranty terms, proper installation requirements, proof of purchase, and applicable exclusions. Ground spikes, landscape wire, connectors, and other accessories are not covered under the fixture warranty.

Dramatic Height with Energy-Efficient Performance

The CDPA76 Integrated Tall Aluminum Path Light delivers a distinctive combination of architectural presence, warm full-circle illumination, and exceptionally efficient LED operation.

Its 61.2-inch height allows it to stand prominently throughout large gardens and landscaped spaces, while the integrated 1.7W LED provides inviting illumination with minimal power consumption. The heavy-duty aluminum body, Black finish, IP65 protection, aluminum ground spike, and direct-burial wire lead make the CDPA76 a compelling choice for residential, hospitality, and commercial landscape-lighting projects.

The GL Chain from Abba Lighting USA is a purpose-built hanging accessory designed to suspend GL series globe lights with stability and style. Crafted to provide a secure connection between the fixture and overhead support, this chain lets you place globe lights at elevated heights for versatile outdoor and indoor applications.

Whether you want to create a dramatic centerpiece over a patio, define an outdoor seating area, or suspend globe lighting from pergolas or overhangs, the GL Chain delivers dependable support while maintaining a clean and finished appearance. Its design ensures the globe lights hang safely and evenly, giving your space a striking visual presence without compromising performance or strength.

🔗 Robust Hanging Support
Provides a secure and stable means of suspending GL series globe lights from ceilings, pergolas, or other elevated structures.

🏡 Flexible Placement Options
Enables globe lights to be positioned at variable heights, perfect for creating ambient lighting over dining areas, patios, entryways, and more.

Simple attachment design makes installation straightforward when paired with appropriate overhead hardware.

The chain’s finish and form coordinate with the aesthetic of GL series lights, offering a cohesive lighting installation.

Constructed to withstand outdoor conditions when used with proper ceiling anchors and weather-compatible mountings.

Each CDPA71 fixture features a broad mushroom-inspired shade that helps shield the LED source from direct view while distributing light around the surrounding landscape.

This design creates an attractive daytime architectural element and a soft, welcoming lighting effect after sunset. The coordinated collection is especially effective when arranged in landscaped clusters, staggered along walkways, or positioned throughout gardens with plants of different heights.

Heavy-Duty Cast Aluminum Construction

The CDPA71 fixtures are manufactured from heavy-duty cast aluminum, providing durable construction for permanent outdoor installations.

The aluminum bodies are designed for landscape environments exposed to rain, irrigation, moisture, and seasonal weather conditions. Their durable finish helps maintain a clean architectural appearance while reducing the maintenance associated with less substantial outdoor fixtures.

  • White for modern, coastal, minimalist, and light-colored exterior designs

Add timeless architectural character and inviting illumination to pathways, gardens, and outdoor living spaces with the CDPA72 Heavy-Duty Cast Aluminum Path Light from ABBA Lighting USA. Classic Three-Tier Pagoda Design

The CDPA72 features a traditional three-tier canopy that gives the fixture a refined and recognizable architectural profile. Its layered shade helps conceal the bulb from direct view while guiding illumination downward and around the surrounding landscape.

The pagoda-inspired design complements a wide range of properties, including traditional homes, Craftsman residences, Mediterranean landscapes, garden courtyards, resorts, and professionally designed commercial grounds.

Heavy-Duty Cast Aluminum Construction

Manufactured from heavy-duty cast aluminum, the CDPA72 provides durable construction for permanent outdoor landscape installations. Its powder-coated finish helps protect the fixture’s appearance against fading, chipping, and common outdoor exposure.

Choose between:

  • Black for a clean, understated appearance that blends naturally with greenery and darker exterior materials
  • Brown for a warmer finish that coordinates beautifully with soil, mulch, wood, stone, and traditional landscapes

Both finish options allow the fixture to integrate naturally into residential and commercial environments without overpowering the surrounding design.

Replaceable G4 12V LED Bulb

The CDPA72 uses a replaceable G4 12V LED bulb, allowing the brightness and color temperature to be selected according to the needs of each installation.

Compatible bulb options include multiple wattages from 2W through 5W, with available 3000K warm white and 5000K bright white color temperatures, depending on the selected bulb.

Choose:

  • 3000K warm white for inviting gardens, residential pathways, patios, and hospitality spaces
  • 5000K bright white for areas where clearer, more functional visibility is preferred
  • Lower wattage for subtle decorative illumination
  • Higher wattage for stronger pathway and landscape coverage

The replaceable-bulb design also makes future maintenance and lighting changes more convenient because the bulb can be serviced without replacing the complete fixture.

G4 12V LED bulb is sold separately.

Full 360° Light Distribution

With its 360° beam angle, the CDPA72 distributes illumination evenly around the fixture rather than concentrating light in only one direction.

This surrounding lighting pattern helps:

  • Define pathway and driveway edges
  • Illuminate nearby plants and groundcover
  • Improve visibility around garden borders
  • Reduce dark gaps between multiple fixtures
  • Add visual depth throughout landscaped areas
  • Create a coordinated nighttime presentation

The broad three-tier canopy helps soften the lighting effect and minimize uncomfortable direct glare while maintaining useful coverage around the fixture.

Compact and Balanced Proportions

Measuring 6 inches long, 6 inches wide, and 13.46 inches high, the CDPA72 offers a compact profile that fits comfortably into garden beds, pathway borders, lawns, and courtyards.

Its approximate metric dimensions are 152 × 152 × 342 mm. The balanced height positions the lighting head above mulch, grass, and low-growing plants without creating an oversized presence in the landscape.

12V AC/DC Low-Voltage Operation

The CDPA72 is designed for use with a compatible 12V AC/DC low-voltage landscape-lighting system.

Its replaceable LED configuration makes it practical for both individual installations and larger projects requiring multiple fixtures. A properly sized transformer should be selected according to the total connected bulb wattage, cable length, and anticipated voltage drop.

IP65 Outdoor Protection

With an IP65 waterproof rating, the CDPA72 is designed to resist dust, rain, and common landscape-irrigation exposure.

This weather-resistant construction makes it suitable for dependable year-round use in residential, commercial, and hospitality environments. Outdoor-rated waterproof connectors should be used at every electrical connection to protect the system against moisture and corrosion.

Installation Components Included

Each CDPA72 includes:

  • Durable ABS ground spike
  • 18/2 direct-burial landscape-lighting wire lead

The included ground spike allows the fixture to be installed securely in soil, grass, mulch, gravel, and planting beds. Its stake-mounted design also gives installers flexibility when testing fixture spacing and light coverage before completing the final electrical connections.

  • Hotels and resorts

description:
The PCS01 is a specific model of photocell that functions as an automated switch, designed to control lighting systems. This particular photocell model is widely used for its reliable light-sensing capabilities and seamless integration with lighting setups.

Utilizing its light-sensitive sensor, the PCS01 is capable of detecting changes in ambient light levels. When the surrounding light decreases or reaches a predetermined threshold, the PCS01 activates the connected lighting fixtures, enabling them to emit illumination. Conversely, when the light levels increase or reach a specified threshold, the PCS01 triggers the deactivation of the lighting, promoting energy conservation and providing enhanced convenience.

Additionally, the PCS01 can be combined with timers to offer even greater control over lighting systems. By integrating the PCS01 with a timer, users can not only automate lighting based on light levels but also schedule specific time intervals for the operation of the lighting fixtures. This combination allows for precise timing and customized control over the lighting, catering to diverse needs and preferences.

In summary, the PCS01 photocell represents a reliable and efficient solution for automating lighting control. With its light-sensing capabilities, it ensures that lighting fixtures are activated or deactivated based on ambient light levels, promoting energy efficiency. When coupled with timers, the PCS01 offers advanced scheduling capabilities, allowing users to achieve precise timing and personalized control over their lighting systems.

name: JB08-JUNCTION BOX
short_description:
Body/Material: Heavy Duty Commercial Grade ABS
Finish: Brown
Size: 4″ (W) x 5″ (H)
Waterproof Rating: IP65
Feature: Built in 8 Rubber Cap Air Tight Holes to feed wires through
Included: Ground ABS Spike
Master Box: 30 Pcs
description:
Our JB08 Low Voltage Junction Box is an easy and efficient way to connect all your lighting lines to one place. Junction box’s help prevent drop voltage in your landscape lights and bring ease to mind knowing all of your connections are in one place for future troubleshooting. Additionally, all of your connections are above ground in a dry, weather tight junction box to keep your wires and connections moisture free and prevents corroding like traditional methods of installation.

Our low voltage lighting hub system would be placed in the middle distance of your lighting zone with one wire/cable ran from the transformer to the hub. Inside the hub you would connect all of your fixtures to the end of the cable. Then, all of your fixtures branch off the end of the hub. Lastly measure the voltage in each fixture. If the voltage is below 12 volts, move that run up to the appropriate voltage tap on the transformer until the fixtures have between 11-12 volts. For hub Systems you can use more fixtures per run, daisy chained after the first light connected.

Features and benefits of our junction box hub system is that your connections are inside a sealed compartment/sealed body, contains a removable top, 8 rubber cap sealed cable entrance/exit holes, and a brass threaded spike screws to stake into the ground (stake is included).

This full-circle lighting pattern helps:

  • Define pathway edges

Why Choose the CD43 Aluminum Spot Light?

  • Brilliant Illumination: Features cutting-edge LED technology with a warm white 3000K color temperature that creates a cozy, inviting ambiance. Produces a focused beam perfect for highlighting trees, pathways, and architectural details.
  • Durable & Elegant Design: Built with heavy-duty cast aluminum for long-lasting durability. Available in sleek black or brown finishes, blending seamlessly with any outdoor décor.
  • Focused Precision: The narrow beam angle delivers targeted illumination, allowing you to accentuate specific outdoor features such as trees, statues, or building facades with unmatched precision.
  • Weatherproof Excellence: Engineered to perform in any environment, the IP65 waterproof rating ensures reliable operation even in rain, snow, or dusty conditions.
  • Easy Installation: Includes a PVC ground spike and pre-installed 20-inch wire for hassle-free setup. Perfect for both residential and commercial landscapes.

Key Specifications

  • Material: Heavy-duty cast aluminum for strength and style
  • Color Temperature: 3000K (warm white)
  • Light Output: Bright and efficient LED lighting
  • Beam Angle: Narrow, for precise illumination
  • Waterproof Rating: IP65 for all-weather performance
  • Accessories: PVC ground spike and 20-inch pre-installed wire included

Applications

  • Highlight trees, shrubs, or flower beds
  • Illuminate pathways, driveways, or garden features
  • Accentuate architectural details and outdoor sculptures

Why This Light Stands Out

The CD43 Aluminum Spot Light combines sophisticated design, top-tier performance, and effortless functionality. Whether you’re aiming to create a serene ambiance or add dynamic highlights to your outdoor spaces, this spotlight is the ultimate solution.

Don’t settle for ordinary lighting—choose the CD43 Aluminum Spot Light to elevate your outdoor aesthetics and enjoy energy-efficient brilliance for years to come.

Order now and transform your landscape into a stunning visual masterpiece!
